playthroughs: One playthrough is enough; free-roam continues after the story.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

stages.text: Play the story — five chapters — and enjoy it. Pick up optional missions as they appear: purple icons, plus black icons with pink letters. Scan every new vehicle with the WAiNK app and study animals through the binoculars; both count toward the 100% checklist later. Try each of the nine activity types once for Master of None. Do the Chapter 1 meditation for Positive Mental Attitude when Lucia offers it (see the warning below).
stages.title: Stage 1 — Story first

stages.text: After the ending, Progress, then Stats, gains a 100% Completion entry — that is the checklist for A Long Road. It wants every robbery, underwater discovery, shooting range, drone race and Bret quest, plus 70 of the 80 Challenges, 200 of the 277 vehicle models, 100 of the 255 animals and 15 of the 18 meditation spots. Work through it with this guide's Collectibles and Activities filters. Most count trophies pop on the way.
stages.title: Stage 2 — The 100% checklist

stages.text: Finish the eight Strangers & Freaks strands and the character finales — Andy is Lucia-only, Tyrone and Bret are Jason-only. Then sweep the leftover one-off trophies: the crime feats, the money trophies and the hidden odd ones whose methods are still unconfirmed.
stages.title: Stage 3 — Strangers & cleanup

stages.text: Vice Got a Price! pops the moment the other 54 are earned. There is nothing left to do at this stage — if it has not popped, the checklist above shows exactly which trophy is missing.
stages.title: Stage 4 — Platinum

warnings.text: Positive Mental Attitude may be missable: the first meditation is offered at Jason's house in Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth. Lucia mentions meditating in the kitchen one morning and walks to the balcony — follow her and accept. It cannot be repeated after Chapter 1, and it may be required for the trophy.
warnings.title: The one missable trophy

warnings.text: Cheats disable trophies and saving. Keep them off the save you use for the platinum.
warnings.title: No cheats on a trophy save

warnings.text: There is no mission replay. Keep a separate save at the start and end of every chapter, so a missed step can be replayed.
warnings.title: No mission replay

warnings.text: Do not push toward the Irredeemable criminal profile: it is permanent and makes the police more aggressive.
warnings.title: Avoid the Irredeemable profile

warnings.text: Many optional missions disappear after a while, and some quest givers are temporarily unavailable mid-story. None of it blocks a trophy — every trophy-related quest giver returns in free-roam after the story.
warnings.title: Nothing else is missable
